blocks.text: A magnitude 5.7 earthquake struck off Surigao del Sur on Thursday morning, October 29, 2026, according to the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs). In its Earthquake Information No. 1, Phivolcs said the tremor occurred at 11:19 a.m., with a depth of 10 kilometers. The epicenter was located 125 kilometers northeast of Lingig, Surigao del Sur, at coordinates 8.41°N, 127.49°E.
